title: Sharkskin — drag-reducing textures
problem_statement: Drag limits swim and flow speeds. The problem is documented and scoped before any solution work begins.
concept: Shark skin's denticle texture reduces drag; swimsuit makers (e.g. Speedo's Fastskin line) and ship-coating researchers copy the micro-riblets. Crossover note: the power here is the domain transfer — state explicitly what each domain contributes.
novelty_assessment: Surface texture as a speed technology.
